title: Acceptance protocol: medians of five fresh-daemon unprofiled cold/warm pairs per build
outcome: Every before/after claim on cold-start optimization is judged on medians of five fresh-daemon, unprofiled cold/warm pairs, same command and RavenDB commit (a49b670) as the baseline, on a stated PhoenixCodeNav build stamp; single runs are not evidence. Reason (w-418276aea485 late notes, 2026-09-05): two fresh-daemon runs on the same source differed in compilationPreparation totalMs 1295.9 vs 2235.8, processWideCpuMs 4390.6 vs 12828.1, busySumMs 2407.8 vs 3604.5, while gcPauseMs held at 525 vs 496; a sampling profiler distorted the public phase totals (preparation 2754 vs 897 unprofiled, metadata 1895 vs 35), so profiled runs give composition only, never totals.
acceptance: Acceptance protocol: medians of five fresh-daemon unprofiled cold/warm pairs per build is done
